edition: GitHub REST API, X-GitHub-Api-Version 2022-11-28, api.github.com (GitHub.com; GHES untested)

token.description: Fine-grained PAT or installation token with read-only repository permissions

operations.name: check_connection
operations.description: GET /repos/{owner}/{repo} for each allowlisted repository; reports write-capable credentials

operations.name: sync_page
operations.description: repository, commit (default branch, since watermark), pull_request (sorted by updated asc), issue (since watermark, PRs excluded)

operations.name: verify_delivery
operations.description: X-Hub-Signature-256 HMAC over raw body; X-GitHub-Delivery as delivery id

operations.name: envelopes_from_delivery
operations.description: pull_request, issues (deleted -> delete op) and push events for allowlisted repositories

limitations: Official documentation was not retrievable from the build session; endpoint behaviour was observed live against api.github.com (ADR-0004)
Pull request listing has no server-side since filter: a full-history pass sorted by updated asc is needed once; later passes skip items older than the watermark client-side
Deletions: only issue 'deleted' webhook events; repository/PR deletions are not inferred
GitHub App installation tokens are not minted here (token must be supplied); GHES not tested
Live verification used credentials injected by the session egress gateway (auth_mode=ambient), which were write-capable: the check reports this and the adapter stays read-only
